title: Hold the Line
description: Bandits, deserters and cultists are converging on the Crossroads from three roads at once, and the region's trade dies with it. I'm committing every soldier I have, Denna and Oskar included. Not everyone standing there tonight walks away.

objectives.description: Rally every Company soldier, Denna and Oskar included
Repel the bandit coalition off the first road
Break the deserter mercenaries off the second road
Root out the cultist saboteurs before they open the third road
Break the warlord who organized all three assaults
Report to Steele who held the Crossroads, and at what cost

notes: Reuses Denna and Oskar from mercenary_07 per Step 3's continuity directive - two of the four recruits, if that thread survives, standing with the player again as veterans. Threat: three roads converging on the Crossroads, the region's trade route. Giver motive: Steele commits everyone, no reserve held back. Consequence: no death flag is wired for named soldiers - the prose states people may not walk away, but nothing in the data can make that true for Denna or Oskar specifically. A later pass could add a world_flags_to_set noting losses if this quest gets a choice_consequences entry.
